auth_details: API key via query parameter key=YOUR_API_KEY (or X-Goog-Api-Key for some newer APIs); create key in Google Cloud Console, restrict by API and referrer/IP. OAuth optional for some server products.
paid_plans: Pay-as-you-go after free credit; product SKUs priced per request or per map load
description: Google Maps Platform provides a suite of web services for maps, geocoding, places search, directions, distance matrix, elevation, and related geospatial data. Developers call REST endpoints under maps.googleapis.com (and related Google hosts) with an API key, and can embed interactive maps via client libraries. Billing is usage-based with monthly free credit; many products remain available under free-tier quotas that change over time.
resolution_notes: Pending live verification of auditor disputes on base_url, paid_plans, rate_limits, and description against official Google docs.
